sources.title: NASA-STD-7002 Payload Test Requirements
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 衛星振動與聲學試驗
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學距環境 5 K 內的要求在 5400 s 通過，但仍須實測斜率及持續時間，不能只看計時器。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The teaching within-5 K criterion passes at 5400 s, still requiring measured slope and duration rather than a timer alone. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 由加速度功率譜密度積分求 RMS，分辨譜高度與總能量。
related.differenceEn: Integrate acceleration power spectral density for RMS and distinguish spectral height from total energy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學初溫 40°C、環境 −20°C、時間常數 1800 s，等待 3600 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：T=−20+60exp(−3600/1800)。 結果約 -11.8799 °C。集中熱容量模型 T=Tenv+(T0−Tenv)e^(−t/τ)；假設單一時間常數、固定環境及無自熱。

以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成 PSD：20–100 Hz 為 0.01 g²/Hz，100–200 Hz 為 0.005 g²/Hz。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：aRMS=sqrt(0.01×80+0.005×100)。 結果約 1.14018 g RMS。分段常數 PSD 下 aRMS=sqrt(ΣGiΔfi)；Gi 單位 g²/Hz，不能把 RMS 值直接相加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching initial temperature is 40°C, environment −20°C, time constant 1800 s and wait 3600 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: T=−20+60exp(−3600/1800). Result ≈ -11.8799 °C. The lumped model T=Tenv+(T0−Tenv)e^(−t/τ) assumes one time constant, fixed surroundings and no self-heating.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic PSD is 0.01 g²/Hz from 20–100 Hz and 0.005 g²/Hz from 100–200 Hz. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: aRMS=sqrt(0.01×80+0.005×100). Result ≈ 1.14018 g RMS. For piecewise-constant PSD, aRMS=sqrt(ΣGiΔfi); Gi is in g²/Hz and RMS values cannot simply be added.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
